# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 20 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 20 | **Condition:** heavily damaged/fragmentary

---

**20:1** [...] You have opened [...] my heart [...] to what You teach [...]

**20:2** [...] I have listened to Your truth [...] and You have [...] my ear [...]

**20:3** [...] the mysteries behind Your wonders You have shown me [...]

**20:4** [...] real insight [...] Your holy spirit [...]

**20:5** [...] You have opened a fountain of knowledge for everyone with understanding,

**20:6** a wellspring of power for everyone who walks without fault, a source [...]

**20:7** [...] they drink [...] from the spirit of holiness [...] for the glory of [...]

**20:8** [...] with all the ages of eternity and their appointed rhythms [...]

**20:9** [...] You have laid out before me [...] truth and what is right [...]

**20:10** [...] faithful love to rescue me and deep compassion [...]

**20:11** [...] insight [...] the mysteries behind Your wonders [...] and who [...]

**20:12** [...] what is the creature of clay in front of You? What is he [...]

**20:13** [...] You have carved the law right into my heart and [...] understanding [...]

**20:14** [...] a spirit of knowledge at work in every act of truth [...]

**20:15** [...] to walk humbly [...] and to love what is faithful and true [...]

**20:16** [...] a broken, open heart [...] the spirit of holiness [...]

**20:17** [...] You have steadied [...] my steps on the paths of righteousness [...]

**20:18** [...] on solid ground [...] walking before You at the edge of [...]

**20:19** [...] the road of life [...] the road of peace that never ends [...]

**20:20** [...] what is the creature of clay before [...] You have carved [...]

**20:21** [...] on the tablets of [...] the teaching of life [...]

**20:22** [...] You have set aside for me [...] truth [...]

**20:23** [...] the rules of [...] to walk in all [...]

**20:24** [...] never turning away from a single word of Yours [...]

**20:25** [...] a spirit of knowledge [...] truth and what is right [...]

**20:26** [...] the holy spirit resting on Your servant [...]

**20:27** [...] to stand [...] before You forever [...]

**20:28** [...] for You have taught me [...] what Your heart intends [...]

**20:29** [...] in Your truth You have [...] held me up [...]

**20:30** [...] Your faithful love [...] is my delight [...]

**20:31** [...] forgiveness and a flood of mercy [...] in Your just decisions [...]

**20:32** [...] a spirit of knowledge [...] truth and what is right [...] the holy spirit [...]

**20:33** [...] You have shaped [...] in Your truth [...]

**20:34** [...] everything Your hands have made [...] for Your glory [...]

**20:35** [...] all their host [...] the spirits of [...]

**20:36** [...] the holy ones [...] the everlasting ones [...] in celebration [...]

**20:37** [...] before You [...] forever and ever [...].

---
*PNEUMA notes: Column 20 is in tatters -- we are reading fragments of fragments. But through the rubble, the voice is unmistakable: a person overwhelmed with gratitude for having been taught, illuminated, steadied. The references to the holy spirit, the law carved on the heart, the spirit of knowledge -- all of it points to someone who has experienced divine instruction as the core transformation of their life.*
